# artisanvirt_backup_target (Resource)

A backup repository. `nfs` targets are mounted on every node of the attached clusters, which allows restoring into another cluster; `filesystem` targets are a node-local directory. Targets cannot be changed in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artisanvirt_backup_target" "nas" {
  name        = "nas01"
  type        = "nfs"
  path        = "/mnt/artisan-backups"
  nfs_server  = "10.0.0.5"
  nfs_export  = "/exports/vm-backups"
  cluster_ids = [artisanvirt_cluster.fsn1.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `path` (String) Absolute directory (mount point for NFS) on the nodes.
- `type` (String) `nfs` or `filesystem`.

### Optional

- `cluster_ids` (Set of String) Clusters whose nodes can reach this target.
- `description` (String)
- `forget_backups_on_destroy` (Boolean) On destroy, drop the records of backups still on the target (the files are left on the target). Without it, destroying a target that holds backups fails.
- `nfs_export` (String) NFS export path (type `nfs`).
- `nfs_server` (String) NFS server (type `nfs`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artisanvirt_backup_target.nas bt-0123456789abcdef
```
